text.style: font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; fill: rgb(108, 117, 125); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Provisional, pending a from-scratch baseline run now in progress. Higher is better and zero is parity with
learning that game alone. On the two games all three methods can be scored on, Breakout and Q*bert, ours
is highest on both and is the only one above zero. CKA-RL's +0.31 on Boxing is the only other positive
value, on a game ours has no curve for. A missing bar is a game that method has no usable curve for:
ours logged none for Space Invaders or Boxing, its run having resumed mid-sequence, and Pong is
ill-conditioned for everyone because the baseline saturates before the window opens. CLEAR logged no
curves at all. Single seed, so no error bars. Normalised by the from-scratch expert peak, which is the
reference this definition calls for, not by the Joint ceiling the other figures use.
